What Are Dental Crowns?

A dental crown is a custom-made cap that covers and protects a tooth that has been weakened by decay, cracks, or a root canal. Unlike a simple filling, a crown restores both the strength and appearance of the tooth, allowing it to function like normal again. At Valencia Smile Expert, we craft crowns from durable porcelain and ceramic materials that are carefully matched to your natural teeth, so your smile looks seamless.

Crowns are often used to:

items.text: Strengthen teeth that have large fillings or fractures
Improve the look of discolored or misshapen teeth
Protect a tooth after root canal treatment

children.html: Who Needs Dental Crowns?

Not every dental issue requires a crown, but they’re often the best choice when a tooth is too weak to be repaired with a filling. At Valencia Smile Expert, we recommend dental crowns in Santa Clarita for patients who have:

items.text:
Cracked or Broken Teeth

RestCrowns act like a protective shield, preventing cracks from spreading and preserving the natural tooth.

Severely Worn-Down Teeth

Grinding, clenching, or natural wear can shorten teeth over time. A crown restores their height and function.

Large Fillings

When too much tooth structure is missing, a crown provides strength and stability where a filling can’t.

Root Canal–Treated Teeth

After a root canal, teeth are more fragile. A crown reinforces the tooth and helps prevent fractures.

Cosmetic Concerns

Crowns can cover discolored, misshapen, or uneven teeth, improving both appearance and confidence.

children.html: If you’re experiencing discomfort, sensitivity, or visible damage, a crown can help preserve your natural tooth and restore full function. children.html: Our Dental Crown Procedure – What to Expect
We make your tooth implant process as smooth and comfortable as possible—combining advanced technology with personalized, compassionate care. Here’s how it works:

children.title: Step 1: Exam and Preparation
children.desc: We begin with a full exam, then reshape the damaged tooth so it can securely hold a crown. A digital impression is taken for accuracy and comfort.

children.title: Step 2: Temporary Protection
children.desc: A temporary crown is placed to protect your tooth and keep your smile functional while your custom crown is crafted in the lab.

children.title: Step 3: Final Placement
children.desc: Your permanent crown is bonded in place, adjusted for a natural bite, and polished so it blends seamlessly with your surrounding teeth.

children.html: Caring for Your New Dental Crown
Taking care of your crown is simple and helps ensure it lasts for many years. Here’s what to keep in mind before and after treatment:
Before Treatment

items.text: Keep up with your daily brushing and flossing routine
Avoid chewing on very hard foods if your tooth is already cracked or weakened
Let us know about any dental sensitivity or grinding habits so we can plan the best approach

children.html: After Treatment

items.text: Brush and floss as you normally would, paying attention to the gumline around the crown
Avoid sticky or hard foods during the first few days while you adjust
Schedule regular checkups so we can monitor your crown and overall oral health
If you grind your teeth at night, ask about a custom night guard to protect your crown and other teeth

Frequently Asked Questions About Dental Crowns

items.title: How long do dental crowns last?

children.html: With good oral hygiene and regular checkups, most crowns last 10–15 years, and some even longer.
The procedure is not painful. We use local anesthetic to numb the tooth, and sedation options are available for patients with dental anxiety.

items.title: What are dental crowns made of?

children.html: Most crowns are made from porcelain, ceramic, metal, or a combination of materials. At Valencia Smile Expert, we focus on porcelain and ceramic because they are strong, durable, and blend naturally with your smile. You can also explore the Cleveland Clinic’s overview of dental crowns for more details on the different types available.

items.title: How much do dental crowns cost in Santa Clarita?

children.html: The cost can vary depending on the type of crown and your insurance coverage. We offer transparent pricing and flexible financing to keep treatment affordable. Give us a call to discuss your coverage and payment options.

items.title: Can I get a same-day crown?

children.html: In some cases, yes. If you have a dental emergency, we’ll do everything possible to see you the same day and provide temporary or permanent protection as needed.
